get.summary: Returns due dates that match the search criteria.

parameters.name: Year
parameters.description: Return due dates with one of the years specified.

parameters.name: TaxType
parameters.description: Return due dates with one or more of the tax types specified.

parameters.name: Frequency
parameters.description: Return due dates with one of the frequency values specified.

parameters.name: ObligationType
parameters.description: Return due dates with one or more of the obligation types specified.

parameters.name: DeliverableType
parameters.description: Return due dates with one or more of the deliverable types specified.

parameters.name: Jurisdiction
parameters.description: Return due dates with one of the jurisdiction IDs specified. Example - http://ontology.onesourcetax.com/core/jurisdiction:USA

parameters.name: Entity
parameters.description: Return due dates with an entity matching one of the entity IDs specified. Example - 5dcab5c21eadad0fa2988bd8

parameters.name: Client
parameters.description: Return due dates with an client matching one of the client IDs specified. Example - 15

parameters.name: AssignedToUser
parameters.description: Return due dates with an assigned to user with one of the GUIDs specified. Use an empty value for unassigned records.

parameters.name: OverallResponsibilityUser
parameters.description: Return due dates with an overall responsibility user with one of the GUIDs specified. Use an empty value for unassigned records.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: Return due dates that have one of the states specified. Valid values are [Complete, Open]

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Return due dates using a status with one of the status IDs specified.

parameters.name: DueDate
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a due date value on this date.

parameters.name: DueDateLte
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a due date value on or before this date.

parameters.name: DueDateGte
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a due date value on or after this date.

parameters.name: TaxYearEndDate
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a tax year end on this date.

parameters.name: TaxYearEndDateLte
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a tax year end on or before this date.

parameters.name: TaxYearEndDateGte
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a tax year end on or after this date.

parameters.name: ReminderDate
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a reminder date on this date.

parameters.name: ReminderDateLte
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a reminder date on or before this date.

parameters.name: ReminderDateGte
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a reminder date on or after this date.

parameters.name: CreatedBy
parameters.description: Return due dates that were created by one of these user IDs.

parameters.name: CreatedOn
parameters.description: Return due dates that were created on this date.

parameters.name: CreatedOnLte
parameters.description: Return due dates that were created on or before this date.

parameters.name: CreatedOnGte
parameters.description: Return due dates that were created on or after this date.

parameters.name: DateComplete
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a complete date on this date.

parameters.name: DateCompleteLte
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a complete date on or before

parameters.name: DateCompleteGte
parameters.description: Return due dates that have a complete date on or after this date.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: If sorting results by a specific field, order by ascending (asc) or descending (desc) order.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: Sort due date records by a specified field. If not specified, results are sorted by ID.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Offset based pagination - zero-based index specifying the first item in the collection to return. It cannot be a negative value.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Offset based pagination - maximum number of records to appear in the result. Maximum value of 100.

GetContainerItemsByContainerIDs.description:
Class holding the parameters sent to the application web service SDK method GetContainerItemsByContainerIDs
that has the TRTA.Calendar.Entity.Model.Contract.Concert.Input.GetContainerItemsByContainerIDs.IdentifyClient object giving the firm identifiers, plus a list of
one or more container identifiers to request the list of child !:Container containers
contained by by the specified containers.

cs.description:
List of TRTA.Calendar.Entity.Model.Contract.Concert.Output.Container objects contained in the Concert-requested containers; containers hold
a list of TRTA.Calendar.Entity.Model.Contract.Concert.Output.Permission objects as well to indicate the permissions on the container.

GetContainerItemsByContainerIDsResult.description:
Return value object for the GetContainerItemsByContainerIDs SDK method; holds a list of dynamic application-defined 
containers and permissions that are children of the containers requested by Concert in the method input parameters
